markets._comment: Alpha Vantage free tier caps at 25 requests/day. maxRequestsPerRun leaves headroom for a retry. Indices are fetched via web search rather than the API to conserve quota.

sections.title: Markets
sections.prompt: Give a broad overview of what moved markets in the last 24 hours and WHY. Lead with root causes — central bank decisions, inflation prints, rate expectations, geopolitical events, major earnings. Cover major indices (S&P 500, FTSE 100, Nikkei, European markets). Explain causation, not just direction. Keep it analytical, not breathless.
queries: central bank interest rates inflation markets this week

sections.title: Fantasy Premier League
sections.prompt: Summarise the current FPL state of play: upcoming gameweek deadline, notable price rises and falls, injury and suspension news, and any standout differential picks being discussed. Practical and scannable.
queries: Fantasy Premier League gameweek news injuries price changes

sections.title: Data & BI
sections.prompt: Cover notable developments in the data and BI world: Power BI, BigQuery, DAX, semantic layers, dbt, data modelling and visualisation practice. Favour substantive product or practice changes over vendor marketing.

sections.title: Career & Data Leadership
sections.prompt: Cover signals relevant to a senior data professional moving toward Head of Data / Director level: hiring trends, salary benchmarks, notable leadership moves, and thought leadership on running data teams. Skip generic careers-advice filler.
queries: Head of Data hiring trends UK

sections.title: UK Insurance
sections.prompt: Cover UK insurance sector developments: FCA regulatory changes, consumer duty, pricing practices, insurtech and MGA activity, and notable moves among personal lines insurers. Prioritise items relevant to a UK personal lines insurer.
queries: UK home motor insurance market news

sections.title: Milton Keynes
sections.prompt: Cover Milton Keynes: upcoming tech, business and networking events (flag dates clearly so they can be diarised), plus general local news — council and planning decisions, development, transport, notable community stories.

sections.title: News
sections.prompt: Summarise the most important UK and world headlines briefly — a handful of items, a sentence or two each. Draw across a spread of reliable outlets rather than leaning on any single one, so no outlet's framing dominates.
queries: top UK news headlines today BBC Reuters
UK politics economy news today Financial Times
